messages:
Sam P.: Quick async check — consolidating the console observability roadmap for PM review Friday. Short status from owners on dashboards, trace hooks, error-analysis views, and retention milestones pls.

Jess L.: Dashboards: core panels are in staging. PR #3425 open (design changes). ETA Tue for prod rollout once design signs off. @Marta R. can you confirm the error-rate / latency panels cover the new spans?

Marta R.: Ack — will review today. There's a small schema diff for `events.error.context` that changes how we chart aggregation. Also need trace hook header name confirmed by runtime.

Liam K.: Trace header rename merged in runtime repo (PR #3399). I'll cut a minor release tomorrow AM. Plan to deploy to staging and run trace regression tests.

Sam P.: Who owns retention config for traces? We discussed moving low-priority traces 90d -> 45d behind a flag. Need an owner and dependency list.

Jess L.: I opened retention PR #3430; adds feature flag and admin UI. @console-bot created feature flag `obs_retention_phase1`.

console-bot: Feature flag `obs_retention_phase1` created. To enable in staging:
```
bin/flags enable obs_retention_phase1 --env=staging
```

Marta R.: 45d sounds fine for default. Keep 90d for enterprise tiers — need sales to provide exceptions list. @Kate S. can you collect?

Kate S.: Yep — will gather customer exceptions and post by EOD Wednesday.

Sam P.: Dependencies summary: dashboards PR, runtime release, retention flag, infra canary. Proposed timeline: staging validation Wed, canary Thu, prod Fri. Any blockers?

Liam K.: One blocker — log quantization change reduces trace payloads but may change storage billing. Eng-infra to confirm retention effect.

Elena I.: We can do 10% canary with current quotas. Full rollout requires storage quota bump; I'll open infra ticket and loop in finance for approval.

Sam P.: Also small code-review ask: @Jess L. please review runtime PR #3399 (trace header tests) — should be quick.

Jess L.: Reviewing now, aim to approve by EOD.

Marta R.: Left a few comments on dashboard PR — will push fixes in next hour.

Sam P.: Thanks — I'll compile these notes into the roadmap doc and tag everyone for final signoff. If anyone cannot attend the Fri PM review, call it out here.

Kate S.: No conflicts. FYI sales sync Thu afternoon.

Liam K.: Canary deploy window Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for `console-obsv` (10%) — see /deploys/console-obsv/canary/1719018030

Sam P.: :rocket: Great. Will update the roadmap doc after canary results.
